problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of six distinct vehicle types to transport shipments across six sequential distribution legs. The revenue generated per ton of cargo for each vehicle type is as follows:
* For Vehicle Type Alpha, revenue is 8.074 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Beta, revenue is 14.665 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Gamma, revenue is 19.726 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Delta, revenue is 6.668 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Epsilon, revenue is 15.328 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Zeta, revenue is 14.215 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each leg of the journey is provided:
* For Vehicle Type Alpha, Leg 1 consumes 0.877 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.628 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 0.219 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 1.806 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 1.671 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 1.065 (ton-hours)
* For Vehicle Type Beta, Leg 1 consumes 0.395 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.015 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 1.252 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 0.657 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 1.076 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 1.596 (ton-hours)
* For Vehicle Type Gamma, Leg 1 consumes 1.861 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.211 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 1.689 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 0.34 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 1.741 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 1.857 (ton-hours)
* For Vehicle Type Delta, Leg 1 consumes 0.502 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.689 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 1.729 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 1.782 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 1.131 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 1.295 (ton-hours)
* For Vehicle Type Epsilon, Leg 1 consumes 0.575 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.475 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 0.929 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 0.238 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 0.442 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 0.899 (ton-hours)
* For Vehicle Type Zeta, Leg 1 consumes 1.793 (ton-hours), Leg 2 consumes 1.217 (ton-hours), Leg 3 consumes 1.849 (ton-hours), Leg 4 consumes 1.873 (ton-hours), Leg 5 consumes 0.356 (ton-hours), Leg 6 consumes 1.259 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 1 must not surpass 135.174 hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 2 must not surpass 166.942 hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 3 must not surpass 127.627 hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 4 must not surpass 118.811 hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 5 must not surpass 106.797 hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Leg 6 must not surpass 182.141 hours

Given the imperative to ensure that for each distribution leg—Leg 1, Leg 2, Leg 3, Leg 4, Leg 5, and Leg 6—the total processing duration does not exceed its allotted time capacity, determine the optimal cargo allocation across the vehicle types to maximize total revenue.
